recordedAtUtcSource: date -u, read from the shell at write time
isLiveAuthorityNote: this record RESUMES a bounded authority and fixes its remaining caps. It authorises no request by itself: each ordinary window still needs its own committed strategy, plan and live authority
whyResumptionIsNowAppropriate: the Window-02 stop rested on an ambiguity about whether two refusals were evidence about institutions or about this machine's uplink. The targeted recovery series closed that ambiguity empirically, from a proved compliant vantage, without consuming a reserve or changing any policy. The state the autopilot would resume from is therefore measured rather than assumed

resumedAuthority.role: the bounded authority this record resumes. Its window-construction algorithm, concurrency rules, stage ordering, validation policy, artifact discipline and public/holdout safety rules all continue to apply unchanged

window01P5ReviewAndResume.role: the earlier review that lifted the Window-01 P5 stop. Cited to establish that TWO ordinary windows have now run under the resumed authority

window02Adjudication.role: the second ordinary window's adjudication, which stopped the cadence on P5 and HELD two obligations rather than spending reserves on them

recoveryAdjudication.role: the canonical state this resumption starts from

operationalVantageRule.role: the evidence-integrity rule every window under this resumed authority must apply, and whose pre-window network precondition every such window must satisfy. Written in the same commit as this record

stateThisResumptionStartsFrom.recomputationMethod: a 110-entry status map was built explicitly from the committed adjudication chain, every slot assigned exactly one status, disjointness and full coverage asserted, and each class counted independently. The replacement ledger was read and validated with the landed harness and every slot occupant derived with currentOccupantForSelectionIndex. Not taken from the owner task text and not from any adapter-held count
stateThisResumptionStartsFrom.q1Order: 45 -> 54, by ascending selectionIndex per Owner Clarification Q1

p6.evaluation: 19 > 10 is TRUE and 57 < 50 is FALSE; the conjunction is false

stateThisResumptionStartsFrom.doNotExtrapolate: 57 successful slots of 110; not a population success rate

remainingCapsUnderThisResumedAuthority.derivation: the resumed authority authorises 4 child windows and 20 live attempts at window size 5. Two ordinary windows have run under it - Window 01 and Window 02 - charging 2 windows and 10 attempts. 4 - 2 = 2 windows and 20 - 10 = 10 attempts remain
remainingCapsUnderThisResumedAuthority.whyFullSizeIsCharged: both Window 01 and Window 02 stopped on P5 after three of five items. The cap is a bound on authorised exposure, not a meter of items actually executed, so a window that pauses still spends its authorised five

theTargetedRecoveryDidNotConsumeAnOrdina.why: the three-run recovery ran under its own separate recovery authority (6eb14d418d0aa720b1fc3c0749fa48402c217621), not under the autopilot's child-window budget. It assigned no reserve, appended no ledger entry, started no new selection slot and served no obligation - it re-measured occupants that were already assigned

remainingCapsUnderThisResumedAuthority.afterTheSecondOfThemIsAdjudicated: STOP for owner review regardless of state. There is no third window under this record

p59.authorisedActions: none. P:59 is not rerun, not replaced, not classified, and no Jaccard treatment is invented for it
p59.ifItBecomesNecessaryToDetermineCorpusClo: STOP and return to the owner

networkPreconditionNowPersists.requirement: before EVERY ordinary live window under this resumed authority, prove the active acquisition vantage is not the previously identified unsuitable DNS64/NAT64-only condition
networkPreconditionNowPersists.method: public-safe non-institution canaries plus the gateway's own resolution and classification path - dns.promises.lookup(host, { all: true, verbatim: true }) fed to the unmodified classifyIpAddress from src/orgunits/web/address.ts
required: ordinary public IPv4 egress, or a normal dual-stack path
not translation-prefix-only resolution for an IPv4-only canary
the landed address classifier unchanged and still refusing translation prefixes
notRequired: the exact same Wi-Fi network as the recovery used
any particular ISP, SSID or interface name
prohibited: exposing institution hostnames during structural checks
disabling or special-casing any address-policy rule to make the check pass
treating the absence of contrary evidence as proof of a compliant vantage
networkPreconditionNowPersists.ifTheMachineIsAgainOnTheUnsuitableVantag: STOP before live execution. Consume no reserve and create no institution failure from that environment
networkPreconditionNowPersists.reassertionDuringExecution: the same check is re-measured before each live item, not only once per window. If it ever fails mid-window, STOP before the next item, retain what ran as ENVIRONMENT evidence, create no replacement obligation from it and consume no reserve

windowConstructionForTheRemainingWindows.algorithm: DETERMINATE_Q1_REPLACEMENTS_BEFORE_NEW_PRIMARIES, carried forward unchanged from the resumed authority
steps: STEP 1 - independently recompute every current determinate replacement obligation from the committed adjudication chain and the database, never from a carried-forward total
STEP 2 - sort them by selectionIndex ASCENDING, per Owner Clarification Q1
STEP 3 - assign unused reserve positions monotonically in frozen reserve-rank order
STEP 4 - take up to FIVE replacement work items first
STEP 5 - fill any remaining positions with NEVER_STARTED primaries in ascending selectionIndex order, excluding P:59

window04IsNotPrecommittedHere.why: Window 03's own outcomes decide Window 04's obligations. Precommitting it now would repeat exactly the error the Window-01 adjudication warned about, when a failed replacement sorted ahead of the slots an illustrative 'next window' had named

stopConditions: any P1-P8 pause inside a window: preserve evidence, finish only what is already started, start no later work, produce a LIVE_RESULT, adjudicate what is mechanically decidable, and STOP ordinary autopilot
an unsuitable network vantage detected before or during live execution
an SD7 range that straddles the success threshold: pending review, no replacement obligation, STOP
P:59 becoming necessary to determine corpus closure
the second of the two remaining ordinary windows being adjudicated, regardless of state
absoluteProhibitions: amending Methodology R3 or editing any frozen methodology bytes
altering the address guard, the fetch policy, any timeout or any TLS setting
altering Q3 or any replacement-reason precedence
a manual retry, an alternate root, a browser/curl/wget substitution for a work item
dynamic reserve insertion or dynamic replacement inside a precommitted window
a ledger mutation other than the appends a committed window authority plans
a third ordinary window under this record
serving, rerunning, replacing or classifying P:59
